scope: what decides a level besides the seed: the save file, the difficulty, the curses
finding: with one run seed, character and difficulty, two games generate the same level and the same curse only from the same persistent game data; mods (all disabled) and difficulty were ruled out

persistentGameData.readOnlyFlag: byte +1 of the object, Manager+0x15; 1 in every seeded run observed
persistentGameData.fileNames: persistentgamedata<slot>.dat in the profile folder; rep+persistentgamedata<slot>.dat in Steam Cloud, same format

gameFields.difficulty: Game+0x269c8, 0 normal, 1 hard, 2 greed, 3 greedier (Lua getter RVA 0x19e290; Game::IsGreedMode RVA 0x2f8120 reads the same field)
gameFields.levelCurses: Level+0xc with the level at the head of the game object, bit 0 Darkness .. bit 7 Giant (Level::GetCurses RVA 0x348490 also ors Game+0x26550 and two adjustments)

officialOnline.note: read statically from the log strings' users, nothing here was called
officialOnline.matchStart: sets the save read-only, starts the game (0x2f8140), restores the flag, places the players, then loads shared state from a buffer (0x2f6500, pointer and size), checks player count against remote players, binds players to controllers and colours
officialOnline.participantSaves: container at Manager+0x4b414 keyed by Manager+0x4c5a8; the desync report (RVA 0x503040, 0x5032d0) prints four shared save user ids and dumps desync_shared_save.dat

validation.sameSaveSameLevel: 0 of 15 rooms differ, same Curse of Darkness
validation.liveRoomTransitionThroughFormerlyDiverge: right door 84 -> 85, 7 of 7 enemies matched in 208 of 208 frames
